items.title: Aula Magna - West Campus Lugano
items.html:
The West Campus Aula Magna is a partially subterranean (two-thirds underground) facility, designed to seat up to 200 people. It is accessible for individuals with disabilities.

Technical equipment:

  • Projection: Full HD video projectors, ideal for presentations and large-scale projections.
  • Stage: Includes a podium with built-in microphone and seating for additional speakers, which are also equipped with microphones.
  • Computers: built-in computer with Windows operating system, Office package, equipped for connecting laptops.
  • Wireless microphones: to facilitate audience participation or to allow speakers' mobility during the intervention.
  • Connectivity: The room has a Wi-Fi connection for Internet access.
  • ​Controls: Control room to run projections, lighting, sound, and to record audio and video of events.

Rates

  • CHF 1,000/day
  • CHF 500/half day
  • CHF 300/two hours in evening

items.title: Auditorium - West Campus Lugano
items.html:
The West Campus Lugano Auditorium is a modern, multifunctional space designed for conferences, seminars, and other significant events. Located on the third level of the main building, the auditorium features an amphitheatre-style layout that allows for optimal visibility from every seat, accommodating up to 230 people. Additionally, the venue is accessible to individuals with disabilities.

Technical Equipment:

  • Projection: full HD video projector on a retractable projection screen, ideal for presentations and large-scale projections.

  • Stage: includes a podium with built-in microphone and seating for additional speakers, which are also equipped with microphones.

  • Computers: built-in computer with Windows operating system and Office package, equipped for connecting laptops.

  • Wireless microphones: to facilitate audience participation or to allow speakers' mobility during the intervention.

  • Connectivity: each seat is equipped with a power outlet (230 V), and the room has a Wi-Fi connection for Internet access.

  • Controls: control room to run projections, lighting, sound and to record audio and video of events.

These features make the Auditorium a versatile and complete facility, catering to the diverse needs of corporate, academic, and public events.

Rates

  • CHF 1,000/day
  • CHF 500/half-day
  • CHF 300/two hours in evening
